words.ex_en: My grandparents live in Sussex.
words.ex_zh: 我的祖父母住在萨塞克斯郡。

words.ex_en: They washed their faces and went to bed.
words.ex_zh: 他们洗过脸后上床睡觉去了。

words.ex_en: a four-bedroom house
words.ex_zh: 一幢有四间卧室的房子

words.ex_en: We’ve spent a lot on the children’s education.
words.ex_zh: 我们在孩子的教育上花费甚多。

words.ex_en: There were lots of tourists rubbernecking in the street.
words.ex_zh: 许多游客在大街上伸长了脖子东张西望。

words.ex_en: a lovely rose bush with delicate pink flowers
words.ex_zh: 一簇开着娇嫩的粉红色花朵的美丽蔷薇

words.ex_en: Please keep the doors closed while the train is moving.
words.ex_zh: 火车行驶时请保持车门关闭。

words.ex_en: a stack of dirty dishes in the sink
words.ex_zh: 洗涤槽里的一堆脏碟子

words.ex_en: I’ve looked everywhere but I can’t find the map.
words.ex_zh: 我到处都找过了，但就是找不到地图。

words.ex_en: The cat laid a dead mouse at my feet.
words.ex_zh: 猫把一只死老鼠放在我的脚边。

words.ex_en: He lives just across the street from me.
words.ex_zh: 他就住在我街对面。

words.ex_en: We grew up in the countryside, surrounded by the beauties of nature.
words.ex_zh: 我们在乡村长大，周围是美丽的大自然。

words.ex_en: a tropical forest
words.ex_zh: 热带森林

words.ex_en: the Mississippi River
words.ex_zh: 密西西比河

words.ex_en: Lake Michigan
words.ex_zh: 密歇根湖

words.ex_en: the highest mountain in Austria
words.ex_zh: 奥地利最高的山

words.ex_en: Their house is on a hill overlooking the sea.
words.ex_zh: 他们的房子建在可以俯视大海的小山上。

words.ex_en: As a kid, I loved to climb trees.
words.ex_zh: 小时候，我喜欢爬树。

words.ex_en: The bridge buckled in the storm.
words.ex_zh: 那座桥在暴风雨中塌陷了。

words.ex_en: The offices are on the top two floors of the building.
words.ex_zh: 办公室在大楼最高的两层。
